verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS business-services platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows LegalZoom ships one. The pack covers formation products, the web dashboard, notifications and an llms.txt file for AI crawlers. llms.txt is crawler guidance, not a command-line tool, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
